study.title: NAWG framework comparison: January–June 2026
study.comparison: 2026 mean NSS re-expressed on the 2025 framework, compared with published 2025 mean NSS for the same month
study.scope: National aggregate only; no county-level re-expressed observations are supplied.

sensitivity.meaning: Lower and upper values are the study's displacement-flow sensitivity range. They are not a confidence interval.
sensitivity.alternativeAssumptionNote: The supplied CSV does not name the alternative displacement-flow assumptions. The original calculation formula and county-level sensitivity values were not included in the package and are not reproduced here.

study.methodSummary: The companion trend report describes applying 2025 weights and restriction logic to 2026 inputs, excluding climate and conflict, omitting the 2026 automatic adjustment, and adding contextual review once after re-scaling. This reference package supplies only national aggregate sensitivity results; it does not provide a reproducible calculation specification.
study.provenanceNote: Transcribed from the supplied colleague package's inputs/framework_bridge_2026.csv. The colleague builder validates and loads this precomputed reference; it does not calculate the bridge.
limitations: The sensitivity bounds are reference-study aggregates and are not recalculated from ActivityInfo rows.
The exact alternative displacement-flow assumption labels, per-county calculations, adjustment transfer and cap details are not provided in the supplied package.
Reference bounds are shown only when both ActivityInfo national periods have 79 resolved counties and their published means match the study's aggregates within 0.00000001 NSS points.
ActivityInfo published means remain the dashboard's observed values; reference published means are validation values only.
